title: The Last Hollow
author: Emrys Voss
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
